ticket.title: Log the row count of each statement import
ticket.why: Support cannot tell from the logs how many rows an import processed when a tenant reports missing entries; today an import leaves no log line at all.
ticket.what: In `src/ledger/services/importer.py`, `import_statement` logs one structured line per import after the import commits, with the tenant id, the file name, the rows parsed and the entries posted.
acceptance: Every `import_statement` call logs one line containing the tenant id, file name, rows parsed and entries posted.
The line is emitted after the import has committed.

state.diff:
diff --git a/src/ledger/services/importer.py b/src/ledger/services/importer.py
index 5c1a2f0..9e7d3b4 100644
--- a/src/ledger/services/importer.py
+++ b/src/ledger/services/importer.py
@@ -1,11 +1,19 @@
 """CSV importer: bank statements into candidate entries."""
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import logging
+
 from ledger.integration import bus
 from ledger.services.posting import post_entry
 from ledger.storage import store
 from ledger.types import ImportReport, Tenant
 
+log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def summarize(report):
+    return report.rows, report.posted
+
 
 def import_statement(tenant: Tenant, file) -> ImportReport:
     """Parse ``file`` and post every matched row through ``post_entry``."""
@@ -38,3 +48,5 @@ def import_statement(tenant: Tenant, file) -> ImportReport:
     store.commit()
     bus.publish("import.completed", {"tenant_id": tenant.id, "posted": report.posted})
+    rows, posted = summarize(report)
+    log.info(f"imported {rows} rows ({posted} posted) for {tenant.id} from {file.name}")
     return report
